### Observed differences

- A01 was absent from the earlier window (0 of 200 cases). In the later window it runs once in about 39 in 100 cases (77 of 200), around the middle of the case (median relative position about 0.45), and its outgoing transitions go mainly to A09 (about 27%), A07 (about 23%) and A12 (about 19%). [OCC001, POS001, DIR001]
- A17 moved the opposite way: earlier it appeared in about 53 in 100 cases (105 of 200) and averaged almost two executions per case overall — nearly four per case that contained it — at a median relative position of about 0.64, passing on mainly to A15 (about 53%) and A14 (about 46%) of its outgoing transitions; in the later window it is not observed at all, with no outgoing transitions. [OCC004, POS003, DIR003]
- A12's handovers changed accordingly: earlier about 52% of its outgoing transitions went to A17 and 47% to A16; in the later window nothing goes to A17, A16 keeps about 44%, and A15 (about 29%) and A14 (about 22%) become the main targets. [DIR002]
- The co-occurrence pattern matches: earlier A17 co-occurred with A02, A12 and A15 in about 53 in 100 cases each (largely interleaved or repeated) and with A14 in about 30; in the later window it co-occurs with none of them, and A12, A15 and A14 run without it in roughly half to seven in ten cases. [REL006, REL007, REL008, REL009]
- A01's new relations: it now co-occurs with A02 in about 39 in 100 cases and never appears without A02; it co-occurs with A12 and A15 in about 19 in 100 cases each and with A14 in about 11, so it runs both with and without the A12/A14/A15 block. [REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004]
- Gaps between the remaining activities tightened: the A14→A15 distance was mostly 3 steps (about 40%) or 5 (about 23%) earlier and is mostly 2 (about 39%) or 4 (about 22%) later; the A15→A15, A15→A14 and A14→A14 repetition gaps moved from around 4–5 steps to around 2–4 (these rest on roughly 20–55 observations per window), and the A12→A14 and A12→A15 gaps also shifted slightly shorter. [LAG006, LAG008, LAG007, LAG005, LAG003, LAG004]
- Two further activities are executed less often: A06 in about 52 vs 31 in 100 cases (103→61 of 200) and A08 in about 47 vs 30 (93→59); A12's own position within the case is essentially unchanged (median about 0.58 vs 0.62). [OCC002, OCC003, POS002]
- For scale: 27 control-flow items qualified (61 units tested) against roughly 0.3 expected by chance in an unchanged process, and every item's difference exceeded about 199 of 200 random re-splits, so the volume of differences far exceeds what random re-splits of a stable process produce. [DIR001, REL007, LAG006, LAG004, LAG008, REL001, LAG001, OCC001, POS003, DIR003, LAG002, LAG005, REL005, OCC002, REL008, LAG007, DIR002, REL009, REL004, REL002, REL006, OCC003, OCC004, POS002, REL003, POS001, LAG003]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the hypothesis that, in the later window, A17 is no longer executed while A01 appears as a new step. Earlier, A17 ran in about half of the cases — repeated several times within a case — and A12 handed over to it about half the time; later, A17 is unobserved across 200 cases, A12 passes control to A15 and A14 instead, A01 runs once in about 39 in 100 cases around mid-case (always alongside A02, leading mainly to A09, A07 and A12), and the A14/A15 sequence runs with visibly shorter gaps. The participation evidence is direct and large on both sides (0→77 and 105→0 of 200 cases), the successor and relation items all move in the same direction, and 27 qualifying items against roughly 0.3 expected by chance makes a chance origin of the set implausible; the position and gap shifts agree with the participation change but reflect the same underlying behaviour rather than independent confirmations. Limitations: zero participation only shows A17 was not observed, and because A01 and A17 never co-occur and each appears in only one window, the evidence cannot fully rule out that A01 is a re-labelled counterpart of A17 — its single, non-repeating execution and different successors argue against identity but do not settle it. [OCC001, OCC004, POS001, POS003, DIR001, DIR002, DIR003, REL001, REL002, REL003, REL004, REL005, REL006, REL007, REL008, REL009, LAG003, LAG004, LAG005, LAG006, LAG007, LAG008]

Other differences: A06 and A08 are executed in fewer cases (down about 21 and 17 percentage points respectively), consistent with the rerouting around A12 but not part of the hypothesis above; A12's own position within the case is stable. [OCC002, OCC003, POS002]

Let me analyze this evidence carefully.

Setup:
- 200 traces before, 200 traces after.
- Screening: 61 units tested, 27 items qualified, 0.3 expected by chance. That's a count many times larger than the expectation (27 vs 0.3), so chance cannot explain the whole set. All items are control_flow family. So we go beyond the screening comparison and judge by directness, consistency, and ability to rule out competing explanations.

All items have empirical_strength 0.995 (same value, likely because of the reference distribution cap).

Let me group the evidence by behaviour.

Key observations:

1. A01 appears from nothing:
- OCC001: A01 mean occurrences per trace 0 → 0.385, trace participation 0 → 0.385 (77 of 200 traces after). Before support 0, after 77.
- POS001: A01 position support 0 → 0.385, mean position ~0.51 (median ~0.45).
- DIR001: A01 outgoing transitions: before empty (support 0), after has outgoing edges to A09 (0.27), A07 (0.23), A12 (0.19), A04 (0.10), etc. Support before 0, after 70.
- REL001 (A01, A02): before B_only = 1.0 (A02 always present, A01 never), after cooccurrence 0.385, B_only 0.615, B_before_A 0.22, interleaved 0.165. So A01 now occurs together with A02 in about 38.5% of traces.
- REL002 (A01, A12): before B_only 0.53, neither 0.47; after cooccurrence 0.19, A_only 0.195, B_only 0.305, neither 0.31, A_before_B 0.02, interleaved 0.165. So A01 now co-occurs with A12 in ~19% of traces.
- REL003 (A01, A14): before B_only 0.30, neither 0.70; after cooccurrence 0.11, A_only 0.275, B_only 0.195, neither 0.42.
- REL004 (A01, A15): before B_only 0.525, neither 0.475; after cooccurrence 0.19, A_only 0.195, B_only 0.295, neither 0.32.
- REL005 (A01, A17): before B_only 0.525 (A17 present, A01 absent), neither 0.475; after A_only 0.385, neither 0.615. So A01 appears in traces where A17 is absent.

So A01 is a new activity: not observed at all before (0 of 200 traces), present in about 38.5% of traces after (77/200). This is direct participation evidence: an activity added/became present.

2. A17 disappears:
- OCC004: A17 mean occurrences 1.96 → 0, participation 0.525 → 0, recurrence support 0.37 → 0. Before support 105, after 0.
- POS003: A17 position support 0.525 → 0.
- DIR003: A17 outgoing transitions before: mostly A14 (0.46) and A15 (0.53); after empty. Support before 392, after 0.
- REL007 (A12, A17): before cooccurrence 0.525, interleaved 0.42, A_before_B 0.105; after cooccurrence 0, A_only 0.495, neither 0.505. So A12 now occurs without A17.
- REL008 (A14, A17): before cooccurrence 0.30, B_only 0.225, interleaved 0.30; after A_only 0.305, neither 0.695.
- REL009 (A15, A17): before cooccurrence 0.525, B_before_A 0.155, interleaved 0.37; after A_only 0.485, neither 0.515.
- REL006 (A02, A17): before cooccurrence 0.525, A_only 0.475, interleaved 0.43; after A_only 1.0. So A02 always present, A17 gone.

So A17 was present in about 52.5% of traces before (105/200), often repeated (mean 1.96 occurrences per trace, recurrence support 0.37), and is not observed at all after (0 of 200). This is direct evidence of an activity removed/no longer executed.

3. A12's successor changed:
- DIR002: A12 outgoing before: A17 0.52, A16 0.47, small others; after: A16 0.44, A15 0.29, A14 0.22, small others. So A12 no longer flows to A17; instead it now leads to A15 and A14. This is a successor change — direct relational evidence.

4. LAG changes around A14/A15:
- LAG006 (A14→A15 within 5 steps): before distance mostly 3 (0.40) and 5 (0.23); after distance 2 (0.39), 4 (0.22), 5 (0.04). So the gap between A14 and A15 shortened.
- LAG005 (A14→A14): before distance 3 (0.25), 5 (0.18); after distance 2 (0.31), 4 (0.19). Repetition gap shortened.
- LAG008 (A15→A15): before distance 4 (0.83); after distance 3 (0.38), 5 (0.35).
- LAG007 (A15→A14): before distance 4 (0.71); after distance 3 (0.47), 5 (0.22).
- LAG001 (A02→A14): before distances 4-5 mostly; after more spread, shorter distances (1-3 increased). Support small (13 before, 17 after) — weak.
- LAG003 (A12→A14): before distance 2 (0.12); after distance 1 (0.089)... support 60/61.
- LAG004 (A12→A15): before distance 2 (0.18); after distance 1 (0.10)... support 104/97.

These LAG items show that distances between A12/A14/A15 pairs shifted to shorter gaps — consistent with A17 (which used to sit between/around them, repeated ~2 times per trace) being removed, tightening the sequence. But per instructions, LAG uses positions not clock time; a position shift alone doesn't show an activity was moved. Here the LAG changes are consistent with the removal of A17 compressing positions.

5. Participation decreases for A06 and A08:
- OCC002: A06 participation 0.515 → 0.305 (103 → 61 traces).
- OCC003: A08 participation 0.465 → 0.295 (93 → 59 traces).

These are other differences — activities executed less often.

6. POS002 (A12): position roughly stable (mean 0.567 → 0.600, support 0.53 → 0.495). Minor.

Now the hypothesis: The main behavioural difference is that A17, previously executed in about half the traces (often twice per trace), is no longer observed, while A01, previously unobserved, now appears in about 38-39% of traces, typically once, positioned around the middle of the trace, following A02/A12-related context and leading to A09/A07/A12 etc. A12's outgoing flow shifted from A17/A16 to A16/A15/A14.

Is this "replacement of one path by another" or "activities added/removed"? Per the instructions: A change in how often existing paths are taken requires that every activity involved is observed in substantial share in both windows. Here A01 is absent before and A17 absent after — so this is not a path-frequency shift; it's activities added/removed (A01 added, A17 removed). The hypothesis: A17 was removed (became never executed) and A01 was introduced (became executed), with A12's flow redirected from A17 to A14/A15, and the A14/A15 block now occurs closer together.

Support level: The evidence is direct: OCC shows A17 0.525 → 0 and A01 0 → 0.385; DIR shows A17's outgoing edges gone and A01's appearing; REL items show A17's co-occurrence with A12/A14/A15/A02 collapsing to zero and A01 co-occurring with A02/A12/A14/A15 emerging.
